name: Manastorm: leaving a run or failing it by death removes the Manastorm gadget buffs
contract: Player report (#11363): Manastorm gadget buffs cast inside a run, such as the 2-hour Long Haul Liquid, stay on
the player after leaving the run, also after dying in it, so they work in the open world. The gadgets can only be
cast inside a run (the cast guard refuses them outside, #11698) and only from the run loadout, so the run exit
must end them. Every exit removes the baseline run items through ManastormMgr::RemoveBaselineRunItems; it now
also removes the auras of every active gadget, Millhouse's Magical Escape (93311) and the potion regeneration
The case uses Long Haul Liquid rank 8 (293453): a 2-hour SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_HEALTH aura that persists
through death (SPELL_ATTR3_ALLOW_AURA_WHILE_DEAD). It slots the gadget through the native loadout request,
casts it inside segment 1, leaves through the native leave request and checks the aura is gone, also after a
relog. Arcane Intellect (1459), set as an ordinary saved buff, is the control that a leave keeps.
The reported path follows: a second run, the gadget cast again, the bubble left so the run is active, a solo
death (the aura survives it by design), and the leave request that fails the ended run and ejects the player.

steps.label: Long Haul Liquid is cast outside a run
CONTROL: the gadget is refused outside a run
CONTROL: no Long Haul Liquid aura outside a run
Slot Long Haul Liquid in loadout slot 0
SETUP: the loadout request is accepted
Give the player an ordinary saved buff as the control
SETUP: the control buff is present
The player entered a private Manastorm instance
Long Haul Liquid is cast inside the run
SETUP: the slotted gadget works inside the run
Leave the run through the native leave request
The player left the private instance
Leaving the run removes the Long Haul Liquid aura
CONTROL: leaving keeps an ordinary buff
The Long Haul Liquid aura does not come back after a relog
CONTROL: the ordinary buff survives the relog
The player entered a second private Manastorm instance
Long Haul Liquid is cast in the second run
SETUP: the gadget aura is present in the second run
Leave the preparation bubble so the run is active
SETUP: the preparation bubble is gone
CONTROL: Long Haul Liquid persists through death inside the run
Leave the ended run through the native leave request
Leaving after the solo death ejects the player from the run
The failed run removes the Long Haul Liquid aura
